phrases.text: I'd like to order a coffee, please.

translations.es: Me gustaría pedir un café, por favor.
translations.en: I'd like to order a coffee, please.

phrases.text: I've been working here for two years.

translations.es: He estado trabajando aquí por dos años.
translations.en: I've been working here for two years.

phrases.text: I'll call you back later tonight.

translations.es: Te llamaré de vuelta más tarde esta noche.
translations.en: I'll call you back later tonight.

phrases.text: You're doing a really great job today.

translations.es: Estás haciendo un gran trabajo hoy.
translations.en: You're doing a really great job today.

translations.es: Ellos ya han dejado el edificio.

phrases.text: We're going to the beach tomorrow.

translations.es: Nosotros vamos a la playa mañana.
translations.en: We're going to the beach tomorrow.

phrases.text: He's reading a very interesting book.

translations.es: Él está leyendo un libro muy interesante.
translations.en: He's reading a very interesting book.
